shared_elements: geometric motifs including lines and possible circles
horizontal bands or rows of marks
justification: The most specific overlap is that both surfaces contain schematic carved linear/geometric markings, with some organization into horizontal bands or rows. The major difference is that A is dominated by a large anthropomorphic figure with body parts and large emblematic motifs, while B is primarily a rectangular field of many small inscription-like signs with no comparable central figure or bodily iconography.
